user.title: Connect to your Envoy
user.description: Enter the Envoy's address and your Enphase Enlighten login. The login is used to get the Envoy's owner token and to read your battery settings.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the Envoy on your network.

site.title: Choose the site
site.description: Your Enlighten account has more than one site. Choose the one this Envoy belongs to.

confirm.title: Confirm Envoy {serial}
confirm.description:
Found: {layout} · {hardware}.

The phase layout comes from the Envoy's current transformers and can't be changed here. Check the country and time zone; battery schedules use the site's time zone.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Enlighten again
reauth_confirm.description: Enphase refused the saved login. Enter your Enlighten email and password again.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Envoy or Enphase's servers. Check the host and your network.
error.invalid_auth: Enphase refused the email or password.
error.firmware_unsupported: This Envoy runs firmware older than 7.0, which this integration doesn't support. Use the core Enphase Envoy integration instead.
error.unknown_phase_layout: Couldn't work out whether the site is single-, split- or three-phase from the Envoy's meters. Please open an issue with the Envoy's firmware and meter setup.
error.no_site: Enlighten didn't return a site for this account. Try again in a minute.
error.cloud_unavailable: Couldn't read your battery settings from Enphase's servers. Try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Envoy is already set up.
abort.wrong_envoy: The host now answers as a different Envoy.

data_description.live_interval: How often to read battery, grid, load and PV power and the grid relay from the Envoy.
data_description.fast_interval: How often to read battery charge, energy and mode from the Envoy.
data_description.stream_interval: Stream readings arrive about every second. 0 updates entities with every reading; a higher value updates them at most that often, which writes less to the recorder.
data_description.cloud_interval: How often to read battery settings from Enphase's servers.
data_description.allow_grid_relay_control: Creates a "Grid enabled" switch that takes the house off the grid and back. Off the grid, the house runs from the battery until it is switched back on, and that can't be done remotely if Home Assistant or the network goes down with it.
data_description.allow_dry_contact_control: Creates controls for the System Controller's dry contacts: a switch to open and close each one, and its mode, actions and battery levels. The contacts switch whatever loads the installer wired to them.
data_description.backup_load_entity: Optional. A power sensor on the feed into the panel the Enphase system backs up, such as a smart panel's main feed. Adds "Enphase overhead" power and energy sensors: the Envoy's load less this sensor, which is what the Enphase equipment itself draws.

phase_layout_changed.title: Envoy phase layout changed
phase_layout_changed.description: The Envoy's meters now report a {detected} layout, but this entry was set up as {stored}. Remove and re-add the integration so the per-phase entities match the new layout.

maintenance_charge_stuck.title: Battery maintenance: the battery isn't charging
maintenance_charge_stuck.description: Battery maintenance turned charge from grid on, but the battery (at {soc}%) hasn't charged for {minutes} minutes, and turning charge from grid off and on again didn't help. The Envoy's battery scheduler is probably stuck; its last mode was "{mode}". Changing the battery profile in the Enphase app, then changing it back to Full Backup, usually frees it. Battery maintenance won't retry until the battery charges again or you turn Battery maintenance off and on.

write_auth_failed.message: Enphase refused the saved login, so the change wasn't sent. Log in again from the integration's reauthentication prompt.

relay_write_failed.message: The Envoy didn't accept the grid relay change: {error}

grid_check_failed.message: Couldn't ask Enphase whether the grid can be switched now, so the relay wasn't changed: {error}

grid_control_blocked.message: Enphase says the grid can't be switched right now ({reasons}), so the relay wasn't changed.

maintenance_levels_invalid.message: The maintenance charge start level ({start}%) must be below the stop level ({stop}%).

dry_contact_write_failed.message: The Envoy didn't accept the change to dry contact {contact}: {error}

dry_contact_levels_invalid.message: A dry contact's cutoff battery level ({low}%) must be below its restore battery level ({high}%).
